normalized.result: Yes, exactly that. The whole reason I value the saved copy is that it's a frozen snapshot of how the page was on the day I kept it — so it should stay that way, showing that exact captured version and never quietly re-fetching and overwriting itself with whatever the site says now. If it silently refreshed, I could lose the very thing I saved it to protect. So the two should be clearly separate: "View saved copy" always gives me my preserved version from its saved date, and clicking the title takes me out to the live site as it is today. That way I can see both — what I kept and what it's become — and I never lose the original. That's just right.
